summary: UK garage / 2-step: 130–138 BPM skipping kicks, swung hats, minor 7th/9th organ or pad chords, chopped vocals
body: Drums: no kick on 3, swung 16ths, snare on 2 and 4; the skip and swing are the style.
Harmony: minor 7ths and 9ths on organ, pads or piano stabs; bass sub-heavy and syncopated.

Burial (future garage): the same skeleton slowed or sparse, drums quiet and off-grid, vinyl crackle, rain and room noise, big dark reverbs, pitched ghostly vocal fragments. Pair with production/lofi and chain/dub-echo.

Apply: pattern/uk-garage-2step on the drums, then pattern/deep-house-i-iv on the keys four bars later. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 130–138 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one
